# T7 — Operations (retrospective charter, 2026-11-24)

## Purpose

Make the estate's operations a governed surface: incidents, runbooks and postmortems are rows
and documents; every cluster write is an action behind the tenant's own approval policy; the
k8s reads are host-registered and read-only.

## Scope

`ops.incident`, triage, the four write verbs (restart, scale, rollback, flag-flip), the approval
policy and its quorum, mitigation and resolution with a linked postmortem, the host registration
and read actions, and the systemic-finding loop that opens a kata.

## Acceptance

SPEC_V2 §12 T7: an injected pod failure is triaged, mitigated by an approved write, resolved and
postmortemed; a destructive action without the tenant's configured approvals is refused;
restart, scale, rollback and flag-flip are callable. Proven by the executed suite (31 passed,
1 env-gated skip) with the transcript `/tmp/u5a-r9/evidence/T7-acceptance.md`; the manifest `acceptance/programme/T7.toml` is the
gate.

## Controls

The requester never approves its own gate; a destructive call names its target and an approval
for another target is refused; a dry run writes nothing; a caller without the scope is refused.

## Dependencies

T2 (plan spine) and T4 (contracts and approvals) precede it; the systemic loop couples it to T5;
the cluster live proof is deploy-bound.
